::: {.oh-intro}
Open to anyone, not only students in my courses. Office hours are on **Wednesdays, 10–11 am, on Zoom**, in **15-minute slots**. When you book, tell me briefly what you would like to talk about. You will receive a calendar invite with the Zoom link.
:::
